pages.text: Mom spread bread dough wide. Today they would bake olive bread for the feast.
A bowl was full of olives. Lulu rolled up both sleeves. "I will press them in."
Uncle Nino stepped in. "In my day, every throw went in! Throwing is best for this!"
From far away, he flung an olive.
Plop! Past the dough, into the flour tub.
Now a whole handful! Two landed on the windowsill; one went in his mouth. "...That was a taste test."
Not one olive was in the dough. Olives rolled along the windowsill.
Lulu sat close to the dough and pressed in olives, one by one.
Rows of black olives filled the dough. Mom put it in the oven.
A lovely smell spread. Olives gleamed wherever Lulu had pressed them. Uncle Nino was first to reach for the bread.
